title: Interactive Hover and State Pseudo-Classes
ques: Explain the role of user-action pseudo-classes: **`:hover`**, **`:focus-visible`**, and **`:active`**. Write an accessible button with interactive states.
explanation: Pseudo-classes (`:`) style elements based on dynamic user interaction or state without requiring JavaScript class toggles.

title: Structural Pseudo-Classes: :first-child and :nth-child
ques: Compare **`:first-child`**, **`:last-child`**, and formulaic **`:nth-child(even)`** in table row zebra-striping.
explanation: Structural pseudo-classes select elements based on their position within sibling elements in the DOM tree.

title: Generating Content with ::before and ::after
ques: Explain the difference between a **Pseudo-Class (`:`)** and a **Pseudo-Element (`::`)**. Demonstrate how **`::before`** and **`::after`** add decorative icons and badges using the `content` property.
explanation: `::before` and `::after` insert cosmetic content before or after an element's children. They require the `content` property to render and avoid cluttering HTML with purely decorative tags.

title: Advanced Hover Tooltip via ::after Pseudo-Element
ques: Build a CSS-only tooltip component using the **`attr()`** function and the **`::after`** pseudo-element on hover.
explanation: Combining `attr(data-tooltip)` with `::after` and `:hover` creates pure-CSS tooltips that pull copy straight from data attributes without any JavaScript.
